data.name: Quasim
data.gender_notes: Quasim is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name for a boy meaning 'lived', 'existed', or 'born'. It is derived from the Arabic word 'qāsim', which means 'divided' or 'separated'. The name Quasim carries the meaning “Lived, Existed, Born” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Quasim usually hope their child will grow to embody lived, existed, born and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with spiritual significance, reflecting the idea of the divine separation of the physical and spiritual realms.
data.etymology: Quasim belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lived, Existed, Born.”

in_arabic.name: قصيم
in_arabic.meaning: اسم قصيم يُشير إلى الصدق والوضوح في المعرفة
